title: Figma MCP Server — Expanded to 5 New Dev Tools
description: Figma expanded their Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to include Cursor, Warp, Factory, Firebender, and Augment alongside existing VS Code and Claude integrations. Enables two-way UI-to-code workflows with push rendered UI to canvas and pull design context back into code.

title: UX Pilot — AI UI Generator Figma Plugin with High-Fidelity Output
description: Figma plugin that generates wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and full user flows directly inside Figma projects. Features prompt-to-UI generation with AI that produces low-fidelity flows and polished layouts for mobile and desktop in minutes, with iterative refinement through prompts.

title: Deque axe MCP Server — AI-Powered Accessibility for Design Tools
description: Deque launched an axe MCP Server that brings AI-powered accessibility knowledge to design and development tools. Will extend to Figma designers, accessibility managers in Power BI, and more, offering natural language AI agents powered by industry-trusted accessibility expertise.

title: Banani — Ukrainian Startup Raises €850k for AI UI Design Tool
description: Ukrainian-founded startup by Vlad Solomakha and Vova Parkhomchuk raised €850k pre-seed funding for their AI-powered UI design tool. Features text-to-UI generation, design-first AI prototyping, and Pay-As-You-Go pricing model at $0.40 per token.

title: Emergent AI — Reaches $100M ARR in 8 Months, Launches Mobile App
description: Emergent AI, the 'Indian vibe coding tool', achieved $100M annual run rate in just 8 months and launched their mobile app. Platform enables anyone to build full-stack, production-ready web and mobile applications, publish directly to App Store and Google Play.
